named_predicate.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID]
input:
  SRC: {path: input.csv}
  D: {path: donor.csv, types: {SEQ: int}}
intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: D
    key: [ID]
    order_by: [D.SEQ]
    keep: first
    no_match: null
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, VALUE]}
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: str, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - name: VALUE
    type: str
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "P.A = 'first'"
          then: {literal: yes}
        - otherwise: {literal: no}

context.reason: a str column does not admit this verification
listed value None is not a int value

assert_lookup_selected.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID, SEQ]
input:
  SRC: {path: input.csv, types: {ID: int, SEQ: int, LIMIT: int}}
  D: {path: donor.csv, types: {ID: int, TIME: int, X: int}}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, SEQ, VALUE]}
intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: D
    key: [ID]
    filter: 'D.TIME <= SRC.LIMIT'
    order_by: [D.TIME]
    keep: last
    no_match: null
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: int, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - {name: SEQ, type: int, derivation: SRC.SEQ}
  - {name: VALUE, type: int, derivation: P.X}
verifications:
  - assert:
      when: 'P.X IS NOT NULL'
      require: 'VALUE = P.X AND P.X >= 10'
